title: A Postcards for the Weather
author: Ivo Ashgrove
blurb: Kestrel Nakamura, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
